# MIFECO Proposal & Approval SLA Workflow

## Purpose

This workflow governs how proposals, statements of work, and contracts move from creation through review to client delivery. It establishes clear ownership, timelines, and escalation points to ensure no deal moves without appropriate review.

**Governing principle:** Nothing leaves MIFECO without Bob's or the Board's approval where required.
